quarterly_data.quarter: Advanced Energy press release: Advanced Energy Launches 3200 W and 3600 W M-CRPS Power (10-13-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Advanced Energy announced three new OCP-compliant M-CRPS power supplies at the 2026 OCP Global Summit, extending its CSU M-CRPS Series for data centers, AI and enterprise compute, storage, networking and telecom: the 3600 W CSU3600AT-9-3M0 for higher-power 54 V architectures, the 3200 W CSU3200AT-3-6M0 for 12 V output AI and data center architectures, and the 3200 W CSU3200ADC-3-3M0 (12 V output, DC input) for LVDC-powered telecom and OCP +48 V busbar infrastructure. Power density is up to 112 W/in3 in a 185 mm form factor; the AC-input units are certified 80 Plus Titanium and the DC-input model has a peak efficiency of 94%, with cybersecurity and firmware security features built in. VP Marketing Conor Quinn: the products 'can help reduce integration risk, simplify platform development, strengthen supply continuity, and accelerate time-to-market.'
quarterly_data.figure: 3600 W and 3200 W M-CRPS PSUs; power density up to 112 W/in3; 185 mm form factor; 80 Plus Titanium (AC input); 94% peak efficiency (DC input); launched October 13, 2026
